kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَرْطَنَ • (sarṭana) Iq (non-past يُسَرْطِنُ (yusarṭinu), verbal noun سَرْطَنَة (sarṭana))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb from سَرَطَان (saraṭān, “cancer”).
g: to cause cancer, to make cancerous
